mapper.select: SELECT exercise_feedback_id AS exerciseFeedbackId, content AS content, created_at AS createdAt, exercise_record_id AS exerciseRecordId, group_member_id AS groupMemberId FROM exercise_feedback

SELECT exercise_feedback_id AS exerciseFeedbackId, content AS content, created_at AS createdAt, exercise_record_id AS exerciseRecordId, group_member_id AS groupMemberId FROM exercise_feedback WHERE exercise_feedback_id = #{exerciseFeedbackId}

SELECT f.exercise_feedback_id AS feedbackId, f.content AS content, f.created_at AS createdAt, u.user_id AS writerUserId, u.name AS writerName, m.role AS writerRole FROM exercise_feedback f JOIN group_member m ON f.group_member_id = m.group_member_id JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id WHERE f.exercise_record_id = #{exerciseRecordId} AND m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY f.created_at ASC
